angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 144,358 km at 22.55 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 44.3496 +/- 0.3556 mas (same row, RUWE 13.71): 22.55 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.2075 +/- 0.0225 solar radii from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2267 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract): 144,358 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.171 +/- 0.0079 solar masses from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2267 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3030 +/- 100 K from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2267 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2267 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2267.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.037, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2267 A (pscomppars): spectral type M5 V, from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, G 222-3: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2267 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.164 dex, from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2267 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.48149, from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2267 A (pscomppars): age 1 Gyr, from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2267 A (pscomppars): rotation period 0.6958 d, from Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..85Z/abstract)
